name: io.github.glibey/onchain-signals
title: Onchain Signals
description: Pay-per-call Polymarket intelligence for AI agents: MCP server + x402 (USDC) API

tools.name: get_market_movers
tools.description: Polymarket markets with the biggest price moves over 1 day or 1 week, filtered by 24h volume. Paid: $0.01 per call (x402, USDC).

window.description: Lookback window for the price change: '1d' (24 hours) or '1w' (7 days)

minVolume.description: Skip markets with less than this 24h trading volume, in USD

tools.name: get_whale_trades
tools.description: Recent large Polymarket trades and net whale USD flow per market/outcome (where big money is going). Paid: $0.02 per call (x402, USDC).

min.description: Only count trades of at least this size, in USD

limit.description: How many recent large trades to scan

tools.name: analyze_market
tools.description: One Polymarket market by slug: prices, spread, liquidity, whale flow and plain-language signal notes. Paid: $0.01 per call (x402, USDC).

slug.description: Market slug or polymarket.com URL, e.g. 'new-nvidia-ceo-named-by-december-31-2026'

min.description: Trades of at least this size (USD) count as whale trades in the flow analysis

tools.name: get_trader_profile
tools.description: One Polymarket wallet's track record from its most recent closed positions (win rate, realized PnL, profit factor, skill tier), its open positions and recent trades. Paid: $0.05 per call (x402, USDC).

wallet.description: Polymarket wallet (proxy wallet) address, as shown in a polymarket.com/profile URL or in whale trades

tools.name: get_top_traders
tools.description: Polymarket leaderboard by profit or volume for a period and category, each trader enriched with win rate, profit factor and skill tier from recent closed positions. Paid: $0.05 per call (x402, USDC).

category.description: Market category to rank in, e.g. 'politics', 'sports', 'crypto'; 'overall' for all markets

sortBy.description: Rank by profit ('pnl') or by traded volume ('volume') over the period

tools.name: get_smart_money
tools.description: Recent large Polymarket trades labelled with each trader's track record, plus the net money flow of proven (sharp/profitable) traders only. Optionally for one market. Paid: $0.05 per call (x402, USDC).

min.description: Only consider trades of at least this size, in USD

limit.description: How many recent large trades to scan

slug.description: Optional market slug or polymarket.com URL to restrict to one market; omit for all markets

tools.name: list_services
tools.description: Free. What onchain-signals sells and current prices.
